text:
maria: Heads up - during sable-lite-v2 int8 canary Im seeing unstable BLEU regression on zh->ko. Not every run but enough to fail the smoke gate.
maria: quick numbers: imix-200 subset — fp32 detok BLEU=31.2; int8 detok BLEU=27.8 (median across 3 runs).
chen: can you share the exact eval cmd + seed + batch settings so I can try locally?
maria: repro I ran:
```
./eval/run_translate.sh --model=sable-lite-v2-int8 --langpair=zh-ko --subset=imix-200 --seed=42 --batch-size=16
```
sam: I reproduced a reproducible subpopulation. Pattern: mixed Han (CJK) followed by Hangul particles get merged in the int8 build tokenizer path and detok never splits them.
sam: failing example snippet (src / ref / fp32 / int8):
```
src: 我 想 要 將은 승리한다
ref: 나는 장군은 승리한다
fp32_out: 나는 장군은 승리한다
int8_out: 나는 將군은 승리한다
```
sam: note: '將' got glued to following Hangul creating '將군' token; detok preserves glue -> mismatch to ref.
leah: we didn't change the model vocab or merges right? int8 should only change quant artifacts.
maria: correct - only quant profile + packaging differences for int8 wheel. fp32 and int8 built from same repo commit.
tae: quick hypothesis: packaging pulled a different tokenizer wheel (or changed normalization). Different tokenizer releases have modified BPE precedence for mixed-script merges. Also possible that tokenizer upgrade changed Unicode normalization (NFC vs NFKC).
eval-bot: auto-diff: 27 files with token count differences; 12 examples flagged CJK+Hangul merge; top ids: imix-23, imix-47, imix-101.
chen: please dump token id sequences for a concrete failing example for both wheels; that'll show whether the tokenizer itself produced different ids.
maria: token ids for imix-23:
fp32 ids: [1042, 2301, 78, 998, 4502, ...]
int8 ids: [1042, 2301, 9999, 4502, ...]  <-- shows 78 -> 9999 (merged/unknown)
sam: confirms tokenization difference, not decoder randomness.
leah: check packaging logs for dependency pins.
maria: packaging log shows int8 wheel built 2026-02-18 and pulled tokenizer==1.3.2; fp32 smoke used tokenizer==1.2.9. We unintentionally picked up a tokenizer bump.
chen: changelog for tokenizer 1.3.x notes "improved CJK normalization and merge rules" - that matches the symptom.
tae: mitigation plan:
- pin tokenizer to 1.2.9 in int8 build and rebuild canary.
- add a token-parity unit test in eval harness for multilingual shortctx (CJK+Hangul, CJK+Latin + punct).
- add rollout gate: if token parity fails for >0.5% of shortctx samples, fail canary.
maria: temporary operational mitigation: route zh->ko traffic to fp32 pool via console rollout until int8 is verified.
sam: Ill open PR fix/int8-pin-tokenizer with the pin + parity test + failing sample linked.
leah: also add a QA checklist note "mixed-script BPE sensitivity" to model onboarding docs: quant builds must include multilingual token parity checks.
maria: created a quick repro gist comparing token ids + detoks, PR link coming. assigning verification to @maria after CI rebuild.
tae: pushing hotfix branch now and running a smoke.
maria: will monitor the eval dashboard and update thread when CI finishes. :thumbsup:
